defects.title: The late FOR SHARE reads can complete a lock cycle; the package says they cannot
defects.kind: false statement in the package and missing expected result in MP-14; no listing change needed
defects.reproduction: I1+I2 installed, one inference attempt admitted and committed. Session A takes no locks, writes the send mark and the use instant (or only inserts an attempt), sleeps 0.5 s, commits. Session B starts 0.15 s later and does what a revoke does: root, settings, connection, credentials FOR UPDATE.
observed: no lock timeouts, send variant: B ERROR deadlock detected after 1.03 s; A commits
250 ms lock timeout in both, send variant: B canceled by lock timeout after 0.31 s; A commits
no lock timeouts, admission variant: B ERROR deadlock detected after 1.04 s; A commits
defects.bounded: fail-safe: no send authorized after a committed lifecycle change; the aborted transaction can be the emergency revoke
defects.requires: a writer that did not take the root and canonical row locks; not observed, and by lock order not possible, when both writers take the root first

defects.title: Lock matrix omits the down and the preflight; the canonical-order sentence is inaccurate
defects.observed: I1 down holds AccessExclusiveLock on tenant_ai_credentials; I1 up first takes AccessShareLock on attempts, approvals, credentials in that order and upgrades later

findings_not_defects: N1 fail-fast variant removes the cycle (variant only)
N2 the use pair cannot be written once constraints are immediate; the frozen active fixture leaves its transaction immediate
N3 one send authorization per credential per transaction
N4 the send instant must be read after the credential lock
N5 nothing ties the instant to real time; a far-future instant blocks later use until rotation
N6 a second attempt can be authorized at an existing use instant without a credential write
N7 credential and approval expiry are not database rules
N8 a fifth file-name-selecting test exists (frozen contract test, SQLite case); unaffected
N9 receipt binding to one legal entity is by design section 5.2
N10 a revoked inference approval still blocks the down
N11 round trip differs in physical column numbers only
N12 ainv1_credential_use has no WHEN clause (optional)
N13 inference bounds hard-code the legacy envelope
N14 existing gateway queries filter on connection_probe
required_changes: Correct the statement about the late FOR SHARE reads in sections 3.6, 5.2 and 12 answer 1 and state the writer lock invariant; or adopt fail-fast reads and re-rehearse the changed listing.
Give MP-14 expected results for the variants without writer locks, naming the D1 interleavings for admission and send authorization.
Complete section 5.1 with the locks of the down and of the preflight and reword the canonical-order sentence.
